verdict.rationale: Sentry documents AI agent tracing: capturing traces, LLM calls, conversations and tool calls, plus replaying past conversations and comparing models and prompts. Nothing in the evidence shows curating datasets from those traces or running offline evaluations against them. Replaying a conversation for debugging is not dataset curation or evaluation, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can curate datasets from production traces and run offline evaluations against them
